_comment: E2E (manual): agent uses gsheets_run_python with mode=update_in_place to apply a 10% discount only to 'Electronics' rows of an existing 'Sales' tab. Asserts that only changed cells are written. Requires GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS + a writable spreadsheet with a 'Sales' tab pre-seeded with product_id, category, price columns. Operator should replace the spreadsheet ID below with their own writable sheet, or set up the Sales tab first via gsheets_run_python with mode=replace. Manual run: set -a; source .env; set +a; export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/sa.json; cargo run --release --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/agents/gsheets_update_in_place.json --agent-session-id e2e_update_$(date +%s) > /tmp/colmena_e2e/gsheets_update_in_place.sse 2>&1

test_payload.prompt: Use spreadsheet 1F7AsFx4yW4uVnJRaRWwpzQuSNvruqGohI2B2NRygT-Y. On the 'Sales' tab (which has product_id, category, price columns), apply a 10% discount to all products whose category is 'Electronics'. Use gsheets_run_python with output_sheets in update_in_place mode (key=product_id, columns=['price']) so only the changed cells are written — never re-upload the whole tab. Report cells_changed.

config.system_message: You are a data analyst. Use gsheets_run_python with output_sheets in update_in_place mode (see the gsheets-cross-sheet-analysis skill). Do NOT read and re-upload rows; you want a diff-write — the dispatcher does the actual cell-by-cell patch.
